Method of Attack: Stripped the package of most of its original content, leaving only an __init__.py and example.py file behind. The code within both files is identical and straightforward: downloads and executes a malicious executable from a hardcoded IP address.
Impacted Systems: Developer systems with dependencies on django-log-tracker without a version specified or a flexible version specified in their dependency file
Attack Vector: Compromised PyPI account leading to the publication of a malicious update
Supply-chain attack via a compromised PyPI account
